text:
mira (design): New suggestion for the latency dashboard header: compress controls into one line to reduce vertical space on small screens. Presets: 30s / 1m / 5m / 30m. Custom opens modal. Sampling as a collapsed pill with chevron. Sketch: https://figma.com/file/xyz liam (frontend): Compact looks good. Two practical asks: (1) indicate non-default sampling on the pill (dot or %), (2) animate expansion (fade + slide) to avoid jank. noor (eng): Backend note: sampling parameter changes route behavior (different aggregation). Please put sampling_pct in query string so caches are consistent. Also add debounce for slider updates (200ms). carmen (pm): Product note: default sampling 25% for new orgs. We need telemetry: preset_click vs custom_open vs sampling_change. That will inform default presets later. ravi (a11y): Accessibility checklist highlights: presets must be keyboard-focusable and announced; sampling pill should expose aria-expanded and aria-controls; slider needs aria-valuetext like "Sampling: 25%"; when time range changes the chart update should be announced via aria-live polite. Also contrast fixes for small legend chips on dark theme. mira (design): Proposed micro-copy for sampling tooltip: "Sampling reduces storage and processing; may hide short spikes." Short, concrete. Also plan: show low-density overlay when sampling <=5% with text "low sampling 6#x2014; expect noise" and a subtle crosshatch pattern on cells for colorblind users. liam (frontend): Implementation sketch: ```
[30s][1m][5m][30m]
Sampling 25%
``` Panel contains `` with `aria-valuetext=\"Sampling: 25%\"`. Will debounce network calls. noor (eng): Confirmed: add `?sampling_pct=25` to route and fire `latency_sampling_change` events. Server will compute p95 on range change and cache for 1s. Keep p95 as a separate pinned element to avoid heavy rerenders. carmen (pm): Decision for v1: ship compact toolbar, custom modal, collapsed sampling pill (default 25%), p95 pinned. Follow-ups: ravi to provide full a11y checklist; liam to deliver prototype; noor to add query param & telemetry. ux-research-bot: Note: quick poll scheduled in #ux-sync about micro-copy A/B ("Sampling quick mode" vs "Sampling retain detail") at 1969000100. ravi (a11y): I'll draft checklist: focus order, listbox semantics for presets, aria-live phrasing examples, keyboard flow for custom modal, slider aria patterns, tooltip semantics, contrast targets. liam (frontend): I'll prototype collapsed pill + low-density overlay (pattern + badge) by end of week. Will include expand animation and keyboard interactions. mira (design): Thanks team. I'll iterate mock with contrast adjustments and bring to UX sync. :white_check_mark:
